issue.title: mdsite build fails with 'no such file or directory' on my Windows machine
issue.author: kwame-dev
issue.body:
I just installed mdsite and tried to build the starter site.

```
> mdsite build
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'D:\Projects\Client%20Work\site\content\about.md'
    at async open (node:internal/fs/promises:639:25)
    at async readPage (file:///C:/Users/kwame/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/mdsite/dist/build.js:88:16)
```

The file is definitely there. The same project builds fine on my Mac.

openIssues.title: Build crashes with ENOENT when the project path contains spaces
openIssues.body: On Windows 11, running mdsite build in C:\Users\me\My Sites\blog fails with Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\me\My%20Sites\blog\content\index.md'. Moving the folder to a path without spaces fixes it. Looks like the path is URL-encoded somewhere.

openIssues.title: How do I set a base URL for GitHub Pages?
openIssues.body: My site lives at user.github.io/blog and all links point to the root. Is there a config option for this?

openIssues.title: Sitemap includes draft pages
openIssues.body: Pages with draft: true in front matter are left out of the build but still listed in sitemap.xml.

openIssues.title: Front matter dates are shown a day early
openIssues.body: date: 2026-03-04 renders as March 3 for me in UTC-5. Dates seem to be parsed as UTC midnight.
